scope: One complete plain 1000+6000 CPU Simulation.step window. Coverage and latency fail; not one of three qualified repeats. No rendering/GPU/full Release acceptance.
errors: Comprehensive workload did not satisfy its business coverage contract

dense_intervals.scope: Each contiguous measured interval with at least 90 percent of the complete initial population. Every interval is reported separately; short intervals remain insufficient evidence and no actors are held, replaced or removed.

actual_surgical_ward_return.unit: actual transfer-to-recovery handoffs in the reserved ward

completed_examination.unit: one actual examination completed per participating Visit

completed_treatment_outcome.unit: actual final patient departures with settled clinical outcome

effective_ward_visit.unit: effective ticks while visitor and patient are actually in the ward

comprehensive.scope: Only sample deltas establish coverage. Historical input and prefix are separate. Measured entries, effective visit progress, original-doctor review, real ward return, completed examinations, actual attempts, outcomes and fees are recorded; work progress alone is not a cured or complete-job claim.

reuse_boundary: Existing B01 final validation is reusable only for the byte-identical B02 outcome; mixed is a different complete world. No extra world-validation engine was run.
comparison: B02 and B01 share the exact original v3 input. Mixed is a separate workload row and is not a v3 speedup comparison.
